brief:
# AmberX notification panel (Brett)

A real notification panel inside the AmberX phone app that receives every kind of notification and status from the console, orchestrator, axHub and builds.

1. Typed notifications: build started/done/failed, approvals and veto holds (with Deny / Run now), account status (checks starting/done, expired, limit, no credits), UI Review items, alerts, info. Extensible type registry.
2. Panel: list grouped by type/source, filters, unread counts, search, mark read, clear, pin; tap opens the related screen; action buttons per type.
3. Live status area: current account statuses, running builds, queue.
4. Also delivered as Android push notifications with actions; panel keeps history.
5. One send API every plugin uses (console, orchestrator, axHub); reuse existing notifications/alert hub code (notifications-control-panel groups/triggers/actions) where it exists.

## Rules
Full API + voice + MCP/CLI control; settings in categorized collapsible sections (per-type on/off, sound, priority); 3 UI options to UI Review; phone screenshots; tests; report, STATUS, THREADS.

steps.text: Server core: kinds registry (notify-panel-types@1), classify alerts, send API → alert hub, pins/read/clear, live status (accounts, running builds, queue); tests
Routes + plugin-commands (MCP/CLI), capability axf.notify-panel@1 for senders, voice phrases, settings sections (per-type on/off, sound, priority via notify-control)
Panel view (console + AmberX): grouped list, filters, unread counts, search, mark read, clear, pin, per-kind actions, approvals with Deny / Run now, live status area
AmberX Android push: console alert notifications carry action buttons (open / panel) and the tap opens the panel item
UI Review (3 options as assets, phone shots), report, STATUS, THREADS, PR to the merge queue
